title: JUnit XML, regenerated from the project's own test run before the gate reads it

rows.citable: test:reports/junit.xml::the test case that proves it — the case must be present AND green
rows.onTheExample: test:code/reports/junit.xml::"guard: a fabricated account reference never routes — escalated to review"

removes: the file attribute of each case (the absolute path of the machine that ran the tests)
the time, timestamp and hostname attributes
the working directory's absolute path in any text, a failure's stack included, made relative
normalisation.keeps: every suite, case and verdict, every failure, error and skip with its message, and every count, as the runner wrote them

github.pin: a 40-character commit of stranxik/runward that carries this file, never a branch or a tag

gitlab.include: include: project: (a project of yours the agent cannot write, holding this file), ref: (a 40-character commit of it), file: (this template); or include: remote: (this file at a stranxik/runward commit) with integrity: (its sha256)

runwardRun.onTheSamplePolicy: the tests leg of packages/runward-run/samples/request-triage.run-policy.json, argument for argument: the same command, the report written to ${out} instead of {raw}, normalised by runward-run as this recipe normalises it

control.fixture: the shipped example, written by runward init --example with the runward under test, with the example's lockfile

sabotage.summary: the guard promotes an account reference the registry does not know as verified, so the record routes instead of escalating to review; the committed JUnit report still records the case that proves the guard green

refuses.pointer: test:code/reports/junit.xml::"guard: a fabricated account reference never routes — escalated to review"
test:code/reports/junit.xml::"guard: a fabricated account reference never routes — escalated to review"

doesNotCatch.why: the tests swapped the journal for a copy of their own: every case still runs green, so a regenerated JUnit report records what the committed one does
a credential literal in a file no test loads changes no case: the suite is as green as before

limits: It regenerates what the tests say, and the tests are the project's: a case rewritten to pass whatever the code does stays green.
A case that no longer exercises the code it is named after stays green: that is the coverage recipe's sabotage, which this one does not catch.
Run on a workstation, or anywhere the agent can change the command, it proves nothing the agent did not choose: the command must come from a workflow the agent cannot write.
As a plain CI step its report is declared: nothing binds it to the tree after the run, and an auditor re-running the gate later reads the committed report.
